procedures.OBSDNE_PRAVODLIS_SEL:
DECLARE VARIABLE SUSP CHAR(1);
BEGIN
  SUSP = 'F';
  FOR SELECT CAS, DOBA, IDUZI, INTERVAL
    FROM OBSODLIS
    WHERE IDPRAC=:IDPRAC AND DATUM=:DATUM AND OBJED = 'A'
    ORDER BY CAS
    INTO :CAS, :DOBA, :IDUZI, :INTERVAL DO
  BEGIN
    SUSPEND;
    SUSP = 'T';
  END
  IF (SUSP = 'T') THEN
    EXIT;
  ELSE BEGIN
    FOR SELECT CAS, DOBA, IDUZI, INTERVAL
      FROM OBSPRAC
      WHERE DENTYD=:DENTYD AND IDPRAC=:IDPRAC AND
           (TYPTYD=:TYPTYD OR TYPTYD=4) AND OBJED = 'A' AND
            PLATIOD<=:DATUM AND (PLATIDO IS NULL OR PLATIDO >=:DATUM)
      ORDER BY CAS
      INTO :CAS, :DOBA, :IDUZI, :INTERVAL DO
    BEGIN
      SUSPEND;
    END
  END
END
